settings.heading: Shopify Migration Services
settings.body: We move stores from WooCommerce and WordPress, BigCommerce, Magento and Squarespace to Shopify and Shopify Plus with no data loss and no SEO loss. Close to a hundred migrations completed since 2011, each one rebuilt to run faster, look better and sell more.

settings.heading: What's included in every Shopify migration. Migrating data isn't the hardest part. We don't just copy your store, we rebuild it to grow.
WooCommerce / WordPress to Shopify
settings.text:
WooCommerce might have been a great way to start, but it costs more than you think. Plugins fight with each other, updates break the site, and security, backups and hosting all fall on you. You end up spending more time fixing the store than growing the business, and support usually blames the next plugin in line.

Shopify removes the maintenance entirely. No servers, backups or plugin patches: hosting and security updates are handled for you with 99.9% uptime. Shopify's checkout converts over 17% higher than WooCommerce on its own, and Shop Pay autofills address and payment details for returning customers.

Moving from WordPress to Shopify means untangling years of plugin data: product attributes and variations, customer accounts, order history and the blog content that earns your organic traffic. We map all of it, keep your URL structure intact with redirects, and rebuild the front end on a modern Shopify theme. See how we did it for Nature's Answer, a WooCommerce migration to Shopify Plus.
settings.items:
Full product, variation, customer, order and WordPress content migration
URL redirects and structure mapping to preserve SEO
Replacing the plugin stack with Shopify apps or native features
Theme setup based on your brand, or a complete redesign
Analytics and pixel continuity, QA, launch support and training

settings.heading: BigCommerce to Shopify
settings.text:
BigCommerce only looks good on paper. Most merchants outgrow it: the app ecosystem is shallow, the admin feels clunky, meaningful theme changes need custom code and workarounds, and point of sale has to go through a third-party connector that leads to inventory and reporting problems. Fewer developers work on BigCommerce, which means limited support, higher costs and slower timelines.

Shopify gives you the tools BigCommerce doesn't: over 8,000 trusted apps, a clean admin your team can use without support, a flexible theme system with drag-and-drop page building, an optimized checkout by default and unified commerce across DTC, POS, B2B wholesale and marketplaces.

BigCommerce stores usually carry years of options, customer groups and pricing rules. We translate those into Shopify's variant, customer segment and B2B models, map every URL and 301-redirect it, and migrate analytics and pixels so tracking never breaks. Clients see organic traffic preserved or improved, higher checkout conversion and up to 80% faster site speed.
settings.items:
Full product, customer and order migration with no data loss
URL mapping and 301 redirects to preserve SEO
Theme setup and customization to match or improve your current design
App selection and integrations tailored to your business
Analytics and pixel migration (GA4, Meta, Klaviyo), training and launch support

settings.heading: Magento to Shopify
settings.text:
Magento is powerful, but it costs time, money and growth. Every change needs a developer, so updating a homepage means logging tickets and waiting days. Upgrades break extensions, security patches stack up, and Magento-certified agencies charge a premium for even simple tasks. Non-technical teams end up blocked and the site is heavy and server-dependent, so you are always fighting for speed.

Shopify gives you speed, simplicity and built-in growth tools. It is fully hosted and secure by default, so you never think about infrastructure again. Apps replace expensive custom builds for subscriptions, bundles, B2B and loyalty, and Shopify Plus handles the complexity Magento brands need: B2B pricing, custom workflows, international storefronts and headless builds.

Magento migrations are the most involved we do: large catalogs with configurable products, multi-store and multi-currency setups, custom attributes and ERP integrations. We rebuild the data model on Shopify Plus, replace extensions with native features or apps, and keep SEO rankings fully preserved. Most projects are live within four weeks, and clients report up to an 80% drop in internal dev requests and up to 2x faster product and collection pages.
settings.items:
Full catalog, configurable product, customer and order migration
Multi-store, B2B and international setups rebuilt on Shopify Plus
Extension audit and replacement with native features or apps
URL mapping and 301 redirects to preserve SEO
ERP, analytics and pixel integrations, QA, launch support and training

settings.heading: Squarespace to Shopify
settings.text:
Squarespace is a great website builder, but it was never built to be a store. Growing brands hit its limits quickly: basic inventory and discount tools, a checkout you can't optimize, few integrations and no path to wholesale, POS or marketplaces.

Shopify gives you fast-loading themes, one of the highest-converting checkouts in ecommerce and an app ecosystem that grows with the business. Your team keeps the easy, visual editing experience they are used to, with a platform built for selling underneath it.

Squarespace migrations are the quickest we do, often turned around in about a week. We export your products, customers and content, rebuild your pages on a modern Shopify theme, redirect every old URL and verify the whole store before launch, with a senior strategist guiding you through the Shopify platform.
settings.items:
Product, customer, order and page content migration
URL redirects and SEO setup so rankings carry over
Theme setup that keeps your brand, or a fresh redesign
Payments, shipping, taxes and app setup verified before launch
Launch support and training on the Shopify admin

settings.question: How long does a Shopify migration take?
settings.answer: It depends on the platform and the size of the catalog. Squarespace migrations are often turned around in about a week, WooCommerce and BigCommerce stores typically take a few weeks, and most Magento projects are live within four weeks. A full redesign alongside the migration follows our standard build timeline.

settings.question: Will I lose SEO rankings when I move to Shopify?
settings.answer: No. SEO preservation is part of every migration. We map every old URL to its new home with 301 redirects, carry over titles, metadata and structured data, and keep your internal links intact. Clients see organic traffic preserved or improved after launch.

settings.question: What data gets migrated?
settings.answer: Products and variants, customers, order history, reviews, blog posts, pages and media. We map the data model of your current platform to Shopify's, verify counts and spot-check records before launch, so nothing is lost on the way over.

settings.question: Can my store stay live during the migration?
settings.answer: Yes. We build the new Shopify store alongside your current one and only switch the domain over when everything is tested. Orders placed in the final stretch are synced before launch so no customer is left behind.

settings.question: Do I need Shopify Plus?
settings.answer: Not always. Shopify handles most stores. Shopify Plus makes sense for brands with B2B pricing, custom checkout needs, international storefronts, high order volumes or Magento-level complexity. We'll recommend the right plan on the strategy call.

settings.question: What happens to my apps, plugins and integrations?
settings.answer: We audit everything your current store depends on and replace each piece with a Shopify native feature or a trusted app. Analytics and pixels (GA4, Meta, Klaviyo and others) are migrated so tracking continues without a gap.

settings.question: Can you redesign the store at the same time?
settings.answer: Yes, and most clients do. A migration is the ideal moment to upgrade the design, since we are rebuilding the front end anyway. See our Shopify website builds for how that works.
